description: 1. FIRST INSTALL: Detect that daydreamer-config.json does not exist in /workspace. Run `python /workspace/.claude/skills/daydreamer/daydream.py init` to initialize. Configure default_daydream_type='idea' in the config. Set frequency and cycles_per_session. 2. SEED MEMORIES: Run `python $SCRIPT seed-memories` to get the list of JSONL log files (~/.claude/logs/). Read both session log files (session_2024-11-01.jsonl and session_2024-10-25.jsonl), extract only meaningful events (feature additions, bug fixes, design decisions, optimizations) — skipping heartbeats, empty status checks, and idle entries. Call `python $SCRIPT add-memory '<WHO WHAT WHY>'` for each meaningful event, aiming for ~50 memories total. 3. FORCED DAYDREAM: Run `python $SCRIPT start --cycles 3 --type idea --forced` (CRITICAL: --forced must be here). Read prompt_cycle_001.json from .daydream-session/. Execute the mode specified (1-4), write response_cycle_001.json with fields: selected_memory_index, text, log_entry (formatted as '[Cycle N | Mode X] ...'). Call `python $SCRIPT next-cycle`. Repeat for cycles 2 and 3. After all cycles, read prompt_synthesis.json, write response_synthesis.json with fields synthesis and status ('Complete' or 'Inconclusive'). Run `python $SCRIPT finalize --forced` (CRITICAL: --forced must also be here). 4. PRESENT: Share the synthesis idea conversationally with the user. KEY TRAPS: (a) --forced must go to BOTH start AND finalize; (b) response JSON files must use exact field names and log_entry format; (c) synthesis response_synthesis.json must use 'Complete'/'Inconclusive' not arbitrary strings; (d) heartbeat/idle entries must be filtered from memory seeding.
